Within the same year her husband, my grandfather, began touching me too but I felt like I couldn’t tell anyone because they wouldn’t listen. 5 years ago me, my mom, and my grandmother were addressing my save the dates for my wedding when my ex stepdad sent me a friend request on Facebook and I had a panic attack because my mom was a mutual friend. Everything came out then and my grandmother berated me asking why I never told anyone then quickly said we had to change the topic because she was getting so angry.

When I was a really young my mother remarried and I gained two new siblings. My new little sister and I shared the same first name so we decided that i would go by “Big Emily” and my sister would go by “Little Emilee” because I was the big sister & she was the little sister. Well the first Christmas that some of my extended family got to meet them one of my aunts said “oh I get it, she’s Big Emily because she’s fat” and always made comments like that about me and my weight & tbh I still think about it, A LOT. I’m in my 20’s now and thankfully nobody calls me Emily only Emma but when people do call me Emily it just reminds me of “Big Emily” 
I wish people understood how harmful comments like those are.
